survivors.claim: `--gate-line` text is spliced raw into the printed Markdown Decisions row; a `|` in the gate line splits the table cell so the pasted row gains extra columns and the Decisions parsers (decision-lint, promise-sweep, nextDecision scan) read a malformed row.
survivors.impact: A gate line quoted from test output that happens to contain a pipe character produces a Decisions row the session pastes verbatim and the spec table then misparses.
survivors.evidence: Executed: node spec/scripts/out-of-plan-triage.js --spec specs/20261103/07-the-file-decides-not-the-tier.md --file tests/consistency/foo.test.js --gate-line 'a | b' → exit 0, line 6: `| D9 | Scope widened at build: \`tests/consistency/foo.test.js\` enters the File Plan (gate line: a | b); …` — the cell boundary is broken. Soft because D2's contract spells `<gate clause>` as raw `--gate-line` text with no escaping rule; escaping `|` as `\|` would be an additive fix.
